scope: j2 quota observation and connected eight-yield CPU guard; no hardware proof

leaves.name: connected-eight-yield-workers
leaves.real: NativeSegmentDriver and StagedSegmentDriver through the existing real four-worker NativeWorkerBridge/LaneDispatcher admission, close, publication and reopen paths
leaves.limit: Inherited test_append_yield and bridge fixtures replace pinned model/device tensors, request/allocator and completion events. Bulk token fields are consistently expanded to80, giving enough real4-row chunks for8yields; per_bulk comes from the real AppendYieldConfig. Each request receives the declared synthetic one-row stock handback and finishes before the next cycle, so the supported decode-cohort count stays unchanged. No fake all-rank close/report is added. Physical CUDA/PP stream ordering and model outputs are not tested.

leaves.name: quota-logging-and-lookup-faults
leaves.real: vLLM logger.info and scheduler queue/cache interfaces
leaves.limit: The existing _progress_logger returns unittest.mock.Mock. OSError at logger.info and an iterator failure are declared report-only faults. get_computed_blocks raises if called during quota observation, proving the observer makes no prefix lookup/allocation. Tests verify unchanged refusal state/frontier, the shared4096log bound, explicit passedbulk UID, first8 queue entries, same-length queue replacements and dedupe. No request content or auth is logged.

leaves.name: quota-inspect-source-mutants
leaves.real: quota boundary, observation call and snapshot bound
leaves.limit: Three in-memory mutants remove the observation, allow a ninth yield, or scan9entries. The positive connected test uses both actual driver classes; mutants must fail an assertion with0unrelated errors. Existing fullclose/reopen algorithms remain untouched.
